name: BlackOakTV
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
long_description: BlackOakTV is a subscription video platform hyper-serving black viewers and creators. We make it easy for black viewers to find, watch and engage with the content and creators that most reflect their lives and experiences.
one_liner: A video subscription platform serving black viewers and creators.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Uzo is a lover of all things media and hopes to bring more underrepresented voices into the content the world sees by leveraging his experience in journalism, entertainment, and technology.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Iyanu - an entrepreneur at heart - is a product generalist with experience at companies like Intel and FB where he built custom cloud orchestration systems and products that enable over 120m+ small businesses respectively. He's deeply passionate about building impactful products for underrepresented communities and currently he's working alongside Uzo Ometu on BlackOakTV where they are building a unique black streaming experience.
